reason: A VS Code extension that integrates a locally installed DeepSeek Harness into VS Code's native agent chat sessions, including session management, streaming turns, attachments, commands, model selection, and permission controls.

summaries.zh: 将本地安装的 DeepSeek Harness 集成到 VS Code 原生智能体聊天会话中，并提供会话管理、流式交互、附件、命令和模型选项。
summaries.en: Integrates a locally installed DeepSeek Harness into VS Code’s native agent chat sessions with session management, streaming interaction, attachments, commands, and model controls.

capabilities: Registers DeepSeek Harness as a native VS Code chat session target
Connects to a locally running DeepSeek Harness over HTTP and WebSocket APIs
Streams agent responses, reasoning, tool calls, questions, and approval prompts
Creates, resumes, forks, and controls DeepSeek Harness sessions
Passes editor selections, file references, dropped files, and pasted images to the harness
Proxies harness slash commands and supports model, reasoning, and permission selection
May start a local dsh web process when no existing harness is available
